fact: The fact sheet, updated in 2023, gives the Gendarmerie nationale's territorial organisation as 6 regional circonscriptions, 23 groupements, 64 compagnies, 289 brigades and 305 postes avancés, and states that the gendarmerie is competent over 90% of the territory and 81% of the population; it is a denominator only and says nothing on digital recording.
title: Gendarmerie nationale malgache
